summary: The generation guard prevents an in-flight pre-save read from replacing the cache primed by a successful save, and the added test covers the admin-save race.

evidence: storeProviderSelection increments the cache generation only after the KV write succeeds and primes the cache with the saved selection.
loadProviderSelectionCached records the generation before reading and only installs the read result when the generation is unchanged.
The new DeferredSelectionKv test holds an in-flight read, performs an admin save, releases the read, and verifies the saved selection remains cached.
